name: btn-hover-underline
title: Underline Hover Button
description: A large plain-text link that reads like a heading. When hovered, a thin line grows from left to right underneath the words, then retracts when the pointer leaves.
use: A contact or footer link should stay understated as plain text while still hinting that it is clickable.
avoid: With no border or fill, it can be mistaken for ordinary text when placed on a busy background.
a11y: The visible words name the action and a native focus ring remains, but the underline appears on hover only, never on focus. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large bold white Contact me sits on black, framed by a small wide-spaced caption above and a muted hint line below. The button itself is only the words, with a thin white underline appearing directly beneath them.
behaves: Hovering sweeps a thin line from left to right under the text with an eased motion, and leaving pulls it back. The words themselves never move or change colour.
customise: Only the words are editable in the markup; underline thickness, colour and easing are hardcoded classes, and it takes no props.
weight: light: One line of text and a CSS transform on a pseudo-element.
